# VIT Ranks - Free VITEEE 2027 Rank Predictor, College Predictor & Mock Tests

> VIT Ranks is a free, student-built platform for VITEEE 2027 aspirants. It bundles a
> rank-and-college predictor for VIT Vellore, Chennai, AP and Bhopal, full-length VITEEE
> mock tests, the public 2025 cutoff dataset, and a marks-to-rank reference ladder. No
> signup, no paywall. Maintained by Malabar Matrix.

## Primary tools

- [VITEEE Rank & College Predictor](https://ranks.vhome.co.in/ranks): enter a VITEEE rank from 1 to 2,00,000 and see every B.Tech programme, fee category (1–5), and campus you can secure or reach. Supports drag-to-reorder, PDF export and shareable URLs/QR codes.
- [Free VITEEE Mock Tests](https://ranks.vhome.co.in/mocktest): full-length mock tests in the 2027 pattern (100 questions, 2 hours; Mathematics 40 / 50 min, Physics 25 / 30 min, Chemistry 25 / 30 min, Aptitude & English 10 / 10 min, with per-section timers), instant analytics and a live leaderboard. Free, no signup.

## Reference data

- [VITEEE 2025 Cutoffs, Marks vs Rank & Counselling Data](https://ranks.vhome.co.in/ranks/info): every public 2025 closing rank per campus, branch and fee category; the equi-percentile marks-to-rank ladder; the counselling eligibility rule; the campus-wise rank-band outlook for 2027.
- [Full machine-readable export](https://ranks.vhome.co.in/llms-full.txt): the same dataset and FAQ as a single markdown file optimised for LLM ingestion.

## About VITEEE

VITEEE (VIT Engineering Entrance Examination) is the computer-based entrance test VIT uses to admit B.Tech students to its Vellore, Chennai, AP and Bhopal campuses. Tentative VITEEE 2027 schedule: applications 20 Oct 2026 to 31 Mar 2027, admit cards 25-30 Apr 2027, exam 27 Apr to 2 May 2027, results in the 2nd week of May 2027, then online counselling. Always confirm dates on the official VIT website.

## About this site

VIT Ranks is built and maintained by Malabar Matrix, a small collective of students from Kerala. It is free and ad-free, with no signup. Running costs are covered by voluntary contributions.

## Quick facts (VITEEE 2025)

- 125 questions, 1 mark each, no negative marking.
- Rank list prepared using equi-percentile normalisation (raw marks do not map 1:1 to ranks).
- Counselling eligibility: ranks ≤ 1,00,000 are eligible for all four VIT campuses (Vellore, Chennai, AP, Bhopal). Ranks > 1,00,000 are eligible only for VIT AP and VIT Bhopal.
- VIT publishes 5 fee categories per programme. Category 1 has the lowest tuition and the most competitive closing rank. Category 5 has the highest tuition and accepts the highest rank.
- Annual B.Tech tuition (2025–26): Group A ₹1,73,000; Group B ₹1,95,000; Bhopal Group B ₹1,98,000.

## Data source disclosure

All cutoff figures are scraped from public 2025 sources (CollegeDunia campus pages, GetMyUni, CollegeDekho, Careers360). They are not official VIT figures. They should be treated as a reference base for prediction, not as guaranteed outcomes for 2027.
